Day 27 — Immediate update

  • Diplomacy / Pause: Trump announced a SECOND 10‑day pause on strikes against Iranian energy targets (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET). He says Iran requested it and talks are "going very well." Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.
  • Tactical context: First 5‑day pause (Mar 23) was broken within hours by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr. Risk of repeat violations remains high.
  • Air campaign & airspace: Flight-scan: 555 commercial aircraft tracked; 6 military flights noted (RCH556, RCH306, CNV5327). Airports in Iran and Iraq listed as closed. Civilian flight disruption continues.
  • International spillover: TASS reports two drones fell in southeastern Finland. Origin unconfirmed. Potential remote spillover of UAV activity — being monitored.
  • Northern Border (Hezbollah): Daily activity continues. Ongoing rocket/missile attacks and Israeli counterstrikes reported over the campaign; no specific new incidents in last 30 minutes.
  • Hormuz & maritime: Iran continues selective passage — allowing Russia, China and India while blocking others. Shipping risk and insurance costs remain elevated.
  • Domestic / Jerusalem: Israeli police blocked the Latin Patriarch and the Custos from entering the Church of the Holy Sepulchre for Palm Sunday. Religious tensions rising; potential for local unrest.
  • Russia position: Kremlin (Peskov) says no decision on Russia joining Trump’s proposed peace council. Moscow frames it as irrelevant amid the war in Iran.
  • What to watch next: Whether Iran accepts/acknowledges talks; any US/Israeli strikes during the 10‑day pause; airspace reopenings; further UAV incidents in Europe.
  • 🟢 Good News: Pakistan mediation and US pause initiative could open a diplomatic window if both sides restrain strikes.
  • Threat assessment: escalating
